name: Datenshi-tachi no Enmoku
source:
This time there is a mysterious uprising in the women's dormitory. Rei and Maya do their best to repel molesters with the help of Ritsuko's instructions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这一次，女子宿舍发生了神秘骚乱。绫波丽和伊吹摩耶在赤木律子的指示下，尽力击退色狼。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
